rawCandidates.descriptionText: Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered. Job Overview Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media. About us Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them. We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone. We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world. What you'll do Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way. Write video scripts and outlines. Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos. Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor. ABOUT PLEO

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Manager, you will:

 - Own a dedicated book of business from a purely commercial perspective, focusing heavily on a land-and-expand revenue model through cross-selling, upselling, and driving overall account growth 

 - Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book of business, securing new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned with evolving customer needs.

 - Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success teams, who focus on customer adoption and retention, allowing you to stay fully focused on driving revenue and commercial outcomes.

 - Build deep relationships with key decision-makers (senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders) to understand their strategic initiatives and uncover whitespace opportunities.

 - Use MEDDICC (or similar framework) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring forecast accuracy and high deal velocity.

 - Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows. Leverage customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and quantify value.

 - Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.




WHAT YOU BRING 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

 - Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

 - Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

 - A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

 - Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

 - Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

 - A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

 - Complete fluency in English


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

 - You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

 - You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

 - You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

 - You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

 - Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

 - Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale




THE LOCATION


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.




SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

 - Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

 - Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

 - Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

 - We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

 - For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

 - We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

 - Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work



THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

 2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

 3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

 4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

 - CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

 - Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

 - Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

 - A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

 - Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

 - Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

 - Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

 - Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

 - Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Alongside that full ERM remit, you'll own second line oversight of security, technology and operational resilience risk, giving our technology and security teams informed, credible challenge. It's a rare mix: a broad enterprise risk role with a technology risk specialism, in a FinTech that's still shaping how it manages risk as it scales. We value people from a range of risk backgrounds, so if you match most of what's below, we'd love to hear from you.




WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll work closely with other members in our Risk and Controls team, the security GRC team in the First Line, as well as teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and Compliance.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Risk Manager, you will:

 - Build and run our ERM framework: Work closely the Head of Risk and Control on our enterprise risk management framework, including risk appetite, how it links to our risks and controls, and the reporting that goes to senior management and governance committees.

 - Own technology and security risk oversight: Lead 2LOD oversight of information security, technology and operational resilience risk, setting the methodology and standards and challenging the First Line on where the gaps are.

 - Test our IT general controls: Run ITGC testing with our technology and security teams, assessing whether controls are well designed and working in practice.

 - Lead high-risk testing when incidents happen: Partner with our Assurance & Controls Manager to lead incident-driven testing in our highest-risk areas and turn findings into clear actions.

 - Run risk assessments and RCSAs: Lead risk assessments and risk and control self-assessments across the business, not just in technology.

 - Shape our GRC tooling: Run GRC tools and help decide how we bring more structure and automation to how we manage risk.

 - Be a trusted risk partner: Advise First Line teams on risk, regulatory change and the control environment, and support our engagement with regulators.

Right now we're broadening what the team covers. We already have strong financial and credit risk skills in the team. This hire closes our gap in technology risk and gives us a second person who can run enterprise risk management end to end. You'll work across a risk universe that spans technology, information security, privacy and operational resilience, alongside product, operational and financial risk.




WHAT YOU BRING 

YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - Enterprise risk management depth: Hands-on experience running an ERM or operational risk framework in a regulated financial services business (FinTech, banking, payments or similar), including risk appetite, risk reporting and RCSAs. You could step in for the Head of Risk and Control when needed.

 - Technology risk know-how: Hands-on experience applying security, technology and operational resilience risk methodology and standards, with enough depth to challenge technology and security teams credibly. You don't need to be an engineer.

 - Controls testing experience: A track record of ITGC testing or similar control testing and assurance work.

 - The ability to influence: Confidence engaging stakeholders on complex or sensitive risk topics, challenging constructively and being heard.

 - Clear, collaborative communication: The ability to translate risk concepts into practical language for everyone from engineers to senior leadership.

 - A pragmatic mindset: A drive to find workable answers to real risk challenges rather than defaulting to theory.

Nice to have:

 - First Line experience, for example in an IT, security or GRC team before moving into second line risk

 - Experience with GRC tooling, including selecting or rolling out a platform

 - Exposure to data risk or AI risk

 - Experience at both a FinTech and a traditional bank or payments business



HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 
IN YOUR FIRST 12 MONTHS AT PLEO, YOU’LL:

 - Get under the skin of Pleo's risk landscape and take ownership of key 2LOD review and challenge activities across priority business areas.

 - Play an active role in evolving our risk framework as the company continues to scale — contributing your expertise to initiatives that will shape how we manage risk for years to come.

 - Build strong relationships across the business, establishing yourself as a credible and trusted voice on risk matters.

We're committed to helping you grow here, whether that means deepening your technical expertise, expanding your regulatory knowledge, or stepping into broader leadership responsibilities as the team develops.



WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You've run enterprise or operational risk frameworks and want to go deeper on technology and security risk

 - You started in IT, security or technology risk and have since moved into broad, enterprise-wide risk management

 - You enjoy building and improving frameworks in a scaling business, and want to be a genuine deputy to the head of the function

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - Your experience is mainly First Line security or GRC work without broad enterprise risk management. This role covers the whole risk universe, not just technology

 - Your background is primarily consultancy, internal audit or compliance without substantial hands-on risk and control experience

 - You want a mature, settled framework to maintain. A lot of this role is building, testing and piloting while the business moves around you




HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 12 months at Pleo, you'll:

 - Take ownership of key ERM framework deliverables alongside the Head of Risk and Control, including risk appetite linkage and committee reporting

 - Set our technology and operational resilience risk methodology and complete a full cycle of ITGC testing

 - Run a GRC tooling pilot through to a clear recommendation on how we manage risk at scale

As deputy to the head of the function, you'll get broad exposure to senior stakeholders and governance, with room to grow into wider leadership as the team develops.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our team of Revenue Operations professionals is highly collaborative and dedicated to building a scalable, reliable, and connected revenue operating system. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Business Systems, and Finance to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations, you will:

 - Lead complex technical programs across the revenue technology ecosystem – from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, implementation, UAT, launch, and post-launch adoption.

 - Translate requirements bidirectionally – turn complex commercial challenges into precise technical specs for Engineering and Data teams, while breaking down technical trade-offs, system dependencies, and risks for business stakeholders.

 - Drive revenue systems and CRM initiatives – optimize architecture and end-to-end data flows across lead-to-opportunity, sales-to-onboarding handoffs, renewal, churn risk, and billing operations.

 - Identify and eliminate technical and operational debt – architect future-state solutions rather than quick fixes, automating manual workflows and improving data integrity across critical revenue systems.

 - Champion modern automation and AI-enabled RevOps capabilities – integrate intelligent workflows, predictive customer health signals, and agent-based workflows to accelerate commercial productivity.

 


WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - 5+ years of Technical Program Management experience – a proven track record of managing complex technical programs involving multi-system integrations, data models, APIs, and technical dependencies.

 - A strong understanding of the SDLC and revenue mechanics – deep comfort with software development workflows (Agile/hybrid) paired with a solid grasp of the B2B revenue lifecycle (lead routing, pipeline, onboarding, retention, expansion).

 - System architecture fluency – the ability to challenge technical designs, evaluate failure scenarios, define sources of truth, and ensure long-term scalability.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influence – strong executive communication skills, high cross-functional influence without direct authority, and the ability to lead governance, risk tracking, and UAT.

 - Experience with HubSpot or another enterprise CRM, modern data warehouses (SQL querying), CPQ/billing tools, or integration middleware.

 - A background in SaaS, fintech, payments, spend management, or a high-growth digital environment.

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You love being the technical bridge between revenue leaders and software/data engineers, translating strategy into scalable technical execution.

 - You think in systems, data flows, and dependencies, and prefer fixing root causes rather than patching symptoms.

 - You want true ownership of strategic programs and enjoy driving them through technical delivery to measurable business adoption.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - Your TPM experience is primarily administrative (focused only on timelines, meeting notes, and status reports without understanding the underlying technical architecture).

 - You are uncomfortable discussing APIs, data schemas, integrations, and failure modes directly with engineers.

 - You need fully defined requirements handed to you rather than proactively untangling ambiguity and challenging assumptions.

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Map Pleo's revenue systems landscape, data flows, and sources of truth, taking ownership of active high-priority technical initiatives.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, and commercial leaders to streamline requirements gathering, UAT, and release governance.

 - Grow your skills in scaling cutting-edge RevOps infrastructure, introducing automation and AI-enabled workflows as Pleo expands across markets.

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 - Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

 - Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

 - Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

 - 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

 - For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

 - We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

 - Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work



THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

 2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45-minute interview with the hiring manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile fits the role.

 3. Pleo Challenge: A take-home test followed by a 60-minute team interview. This is your opportunity to show us how you'd handle the day-to-day of the role (e.g., designing a programme, measuring impact, stakeholder communication).

 4. Final Interview: A final interview with a Senior Leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

 - CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

 - Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

 - A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

 - Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

 - Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

 - Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

If you're excited about working at the intersection of legal strategy and operational excellence, and are passionate about building a compliant, well-governed fintech company, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please note that the role is a parental leave cover and therefore fixed-term until 30 September 2027.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an In-house Legal Counsel, you will:

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for business queries across all departments, providing timely, practical legal guidance on day-to-day operational matters.

 - Support our People team on employment law, workplace policies, and labor compliance, including contract reviews, policy drafting, and regulatory adherence across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Corporate administration by drafting, reviewing, and amending internal policies, procedures, and standardised legal templates that the business can use efficiently.

 - Assist managing fraud and compliance escalations by conducting liability assessments, performing compliance checks, and providing risk mitigation advice to protect the business.

 - Assist with customer disputes and regulatory engagement with the UK Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS), supporting escalations, preparing responses, and helping to ensure we meet all regulatory deadlines and requirements.




WHAT YOU BRING 

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A Cand.Jur or equivalent legal qualification recognised in Denmark.

 - 2-5 years of legal experience – ideally in fintech, financial services, or a fast-growing scale-up environment where you've handled a broad range of matters.

 - Knowledge about employment law and HR compliance – you understand the nuances of employment contracts, workplace policies, and labor law across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Strong vendor and contract management skills – you can review, negotiate, and draft commercial agreements efficiently.

 - Excellent communication skills – you can translate complex legal concepts into practical business advice for non-legal stakeholders.

 - A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset – you see problems as opportunities and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience with compliance and risk management in a regulated industry is a plus as well as managing regulatory escalations and disputes, particularly with financial regulators or ombudsman services.

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You want a real look at how the law works in practice, where you implement it and explain it rather than argue it in theory

 - You want genuine input into decisions, balancing the technically correct answer against what actually works commercially

 - You like building things that outlast you: templates, policies and process that the business will use long after your contract ends

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You want a clean roadmap. The team is under-resourced and the workload is heavy, so expect more firefighting than planned work

 - You're looking for a permanent role. This is a 12-month fixed-term contract covering parental leave

 - You want to specialise deeply or lead. This is a broad, hands-on individual contributor role where you'll be supported, not managing

In your first three months at Pleo, you'll:

 - Take over the routine employment workload so it runs independently of your manager

 - Get to know the business well enough that your advice fits how Pleo actually operates, not just what the regulation says

 - Start shaping the policies and templates the move from startup to corporate needs

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
ABOUT PLEO

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Transaction Monitoring and Fraud Framework Specialist at Pleo in the first line of defence (1LoD). You’ll be the architect of our defence strategy across transaction surveillance and fraud, with a clear focus on leading innovation and embedding AI into how we detect, investigate, and prevent financial crime.

This isn’t a purely reactive role. Within our Financial Crime Framework & Innovation team, you’ll run cross-functional projects that bring together Financial Crime Operations, Engineering, 2LoD, and leadership to design controls and processes that scale. You’ll translate emerging threats and regulatory expectations into practical, automated, and measurable interventions and controls — including the thoughtful use of AI tools to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen governance.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead innovation in transaction monitoring and fraud by identifying high-impact opportunities for automation, model/rule optimisation, and AI-assisted investigation workflows.

 - Run end-to-end change and delivery projects (discovery → design → build → rollout → monitoring), coordinating stakeholders across 1LoD/2LoD, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data.

 - Design and maintain our financial crime frameworks, controls, and procedures, ensuring they remain effective as our products, customer base, and threat landscape evolve.

 - Partner with Engineering on the development, deployment, and lifecycle management of transaction surveillance and fraud rules and models, including performance monitoring, drift detection, and continuous tuning.

 - Integrate AI tools into processes responsibly, including:
   
   - improving alert triage and case prioritisation,
   
   - enhancing investigation quality and consistency,
   
   - accelerating root cause analysis and emerging-risk discovery,
   
   - strengthening documentation, auditability, and control testing.

 - Turn insights from transaction alerts and fraud cases into actionable improvements across the framework, leading with data to reduce false positives, close control gaps, improve prevention and improve coverage of complex typologies.

 - File SARs for all EEA customers.

 - Act as Pleo’s go-to transaction monitoring and fraud subject matter expert, sharing learnings on threats, regulatory developments (including AML/CTF), and industry best practice.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a builder and a problem-solver who can turn strategy into operational reality. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, confident leading cross-functional delivery and taking on responsibility, and you have a track record of driving meaningful change transaction monitoring.

 - You’re a builder and a problem-solver who can turn strategy into operational reality. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, confident leading cross-functional delivery and taking on responsibility, and you have a track record of driving meaningful change transaction monitoring.
   
   - You have significant experience designing and improving transaction monitoring and fraud frameworks, controls, and operating models in a scaling or high-volume environment.
   
   - You have demonstrable experience leading innovation (for example: new monitoring approaches, automation, analytics improvements, or AI-enabled workflows) with measurable outcomes.
   
   - You are experienced in running projects and change initiatives, including stakeholder management, prioritisation, and delivery planning.
   
   - You’re hands-on with data: you can interpret performance metrics, investigate root causes, and translate findings into clear requirements and control enhancements.
   
   - You understand the practical governance needs of AI-enabled and automated controls (documentation, explainability, testing, risk acceptance, and audit readiness).
   
   - You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and you can translate complex financial crime concepts into actionable guidance.
   
   - You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.
   
   - You are an expert within the transaction monitoring and fraud area and preferable also a high knowledge about KYC in general.
   
   - You thrive in an environment where responsibility often will find you and where there is a lot of flexibility.
   
   - You may have been or are a people leader.




WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You're energised by translating complex regulatory and operational challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

 - You have a proven track record of driving measurable improvements in transaction monitoring or financial crime prevention, and you're excited to do this at scale.

 - You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, owning cross-functional delivery, and taking responsibility for outcomes that span multiple teams.

 - You believe AI can strengthen financial crime defences and are keen to explore responsible, explainable approaches to automation.

 - You're a builder and problem-solver who can move quickly while maintaining rigour and governance.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You prefer highly structured, process-driven environments with little room for ownership and initiative.

 - You're looking for a role focused purely on operational execution without strategic input or innovation.

 - You're uncomfortable with ambiguity, complexity, or the need to influence without direct authority across teams.


HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6–12 months at Pleo, you'll:

 - Lead a high-impact project – Own end-to-end delivery of a transaction monitoring improvement (e.g., new rule set, AI-assisted workflow, or false positive reduction initiative) that demonstrates your ability to drive change across teams.

 - Build deep relationships across the business – Collaborate with Financial Crime Operations, Engineering, Product, and Risk to understand how transaction monitoring sits within the broader control environment.

 - Grow your skills in AI governance – Deepen your understanding of designing, testing, and auditing AI-enabled controls in a regulated environment.

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means stepping into leadership of a larger team, taking on increasingly complex strategic projects, or deepening your expertise as a world-class transaction monitoring specialist. We'll invest in your development through mentorship, access to industry networks, and exposure to cutting-edge financial crime prevention strategies.




THE LOCATION

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid, or in-person setup in any of the locations listed on the advert. You will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. 




SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

 - Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

 - Lunch is on us for your work days – enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

 - Comprehensive private healthcare – depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis

 - We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

 - Hybrid working options available

 - We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support

 - Paid parental leave – we support families and want you to feel you don't have to compromise


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 - Intro call – A 30-minute conversation with our Talent Partner to discuss the role, your background, and what excites you about joining Pleo.

 - Technical deep-dive – A 45-minute discussion with the Head of Framework & Innovation, where we'll explore your experience with transaction monitoring design, a specific project you're proud of, and your thoughts on applying AI to financial crime prevention.

 - Stakeholder panel – A 60-minute conversation with representatives from Financial Crime Operations, 2LoD, and potentially Product/Engineering, to assess cross-functional collaboration and your understanding of the broader financial crime ecosystem.

 - Final conversation – A relaxed chat with our leadership team to discuss culture fit, growth aspirations, and what success looks like for you in this role.


A NOTE ON APPLICATIONS

Transparency is important to us, so we wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for to help you set yourself up for success:

 - CV writing and content: We receive many CVs, and we love seeing people leverage AI—it's a big focus for us internally, but without human intervention, these can become generic. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip: use the "Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z" formula to show clear results. For example: "Reduced false positive alerts by 35% (measured by case review and operational feedback) by redesigning our rule logic and introducing a two-tier triage model."

 - Application care: Every application we receive is reviewed by a human because we believe your effort deserves equal care. This means we expect thoughtful attention to your responses. Read and answer our application questions carefully—they make a huge difference in our decision-making.

 - Profile-to-role fit: Highlight why this specific role appeals to you. Help us understand what excites you about transaction monitoring, financial crime prevention, and working in a scaling fintech. If you've worked across compliance, fraud, or payments, make that connection clear.


ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

 - A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

 - Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

 - Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

 - Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

 - Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

 - Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

 - Customer Support

 - Customer Onboarding

 - Sales and Account Management

 - Product and Product Operations

 - Revenue Operations

 - Finance

 - Data and Analytics

 - Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

 - Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

 - Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

 - Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

 - Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

 - Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

 - Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

 - Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

 - Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

 - Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

 - Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

 - Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

 - Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

 - Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

 - Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

 - Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

 - Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

 - Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.




TO PUT THINGS INTO CONTEXT

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

 - strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

 - improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

 - increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

 - creating stronger executive engagement and governance

 - identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

 - improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

 - coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

 - helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

 - identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

 - improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

 - helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

 - turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.




WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

 - Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

 - Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

 - A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

 - Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

 - Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

 - Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

 - Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

 - Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

 - Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

 - Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

 - A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

 - The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

 - Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

 - Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

 - Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

 - Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

 - Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

 - Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

 - You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

 - You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

 - You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

 - You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

In this role, you'll help our SMB and Mid Market customers achieve success and maximise the value of Pleo’s solutions and be part of a dynamic and collaborative team as we scale our innovative expense management platform across the UK & Ireland

If you're excited about solving customer challenges, and driving growth through exceptional service and are passionate about Customer Success in the SaaS industry, then this is the opportunity for you!

 


WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our CX Manager and work closely with teams in CX, Onboarding, AM, Sales and Product. Our team of 30 is highly collaborative and dedicated to Customer Experience.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Customer Success Manager II, your main markets will be UKI customers. You will:

 - Nurture, support and process expansion for any opportunity from the customer base

 - As a customer's trusted product advisor and business consultant advise them on how to create their ideal processes with the tool to optimise their value-add

 - Own the adoption journey of your customer portfolio (after the onboarding phase)

 - Collaborate across teams with different internal stakeholders such as product management, services & solutions, marketing, customer support, etc. to improve the entire customer experience

 - Receive, qualify and triage all inbound communication from all communication channels; email, Intercom (web chat), and/or other performance marketing channels

 - Cultivate key customers to become advocates of Pleo and the Fintech community

 - Manage day-to-day operations and long-term business relationships with our customers

 - Do everything in your power to prevent customers from leaving Pleo through measuring health scores, and product/ feature adoption and acting proactively on those

 - Optimise the product-market-fit by building the bridge between the customer's feedback and our product team

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - You have 5+ years of prior experience in account management or sales or customer success roles

 - You have an open mindset that always looks for the positive. Your customers and colleagues find your energy contagious

 - You love goals and objectives. You don't always need to be given tasks – you create your own tasks while chasing your targets, and it motivates you to reach them

 - You love a fast-paced and dynamic environment, where you have different kinds of tasks - from customer calls to meetings with our product team

 - This is a high volume, high velocity role. Being able to think and do things at scale is a huge plus

 - You are a trustworthy person who always ensures that deadlines are reached, promises are kept, and you do what is expected of you

Lisbon, Portugal, or London, UK

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Manager, you will:

 - Identify and close opportunities within your book of business to grow accounts through upsells, new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned to evolving customer needs.

 - Build deep relationships with key stakeholders to understand their strategic initiatives, and uncover whitespace opportunities.

 - Use MEDDICC (or similar) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities to ensure forecast accuracy and deal velocity.

 - Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows that drive stronger adoption and platform value for upsells.

 - Create custom proposals and business cases that quantify value, align with commercial goals, and support customer budgeting cycles.

 - Work across senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders to land multi-threaded expansions.

 - Lead commercial conversations ensuring terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.

 - Use customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and deepen platform adoption.




WHAT YOU BRING 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

 - Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

 - Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

 - A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

 - Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

 - Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

 - A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

 - Complete fluency in English and German 
   
   


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

 - You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

 - You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

 - You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

 - You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

 - Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

 - Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale




THE LOCATION


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.




SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

 - Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

 - Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

 - Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

 - 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

 - For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

 - We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

 - Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work



THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

 1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

 2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

 3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

 4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

 - CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

 - Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

 - Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

This is not a traditional project-management role focused on timelines, meetings and status updates. You’ll report to our Director, CX and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Digital Content and Self-Service, Voice of the Customer, and Revenue Operations. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to acting as a technical bridge between CX and Pleo’s Product, Engineering, Data and systems organisations. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Finance, Risk and Fraud, and Business Systems to ensure success and keep technical decisions tied to customer outcomes and business value.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Technical Program Manager, you will: 

 - Lead CX technology programs end-to-end, from problem definition and requirements through design, testing, launch, adoption and optimisation. Own scope, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions, and confirm after launch that the technology changed adoption, customer impact and operations.

 - Partner with CX leadership to define the technical roadmap for the customer experience transformation, and help establish the future-state CX technology architecture for Pleo’s next stage of growth.

 - Translate customer and business problems into clear technical requirements and acceptance criteria for Product, Engineering, Data and systems teams, and explain architecture, trade-offs, risks and options to CX leaders in business language.

 - Drive integration programs connecting CRM, Customer Success, Support, Onboarding, Product, billing, analytics and AI platforms. Document customer data flows: where data originates, where it moves, which system owns it and how it is used.

 - Automate repetitive CX workflows and reduce technical debt across customer-facing systems. Challenge automation that is covering up a broken process.

WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - Experience managing programs across multiple systems, integrations, APIs, data flows and technical dependencies, where no single team owns the whole solution.

 - The ability to run several high-priority programs at once, while keeping the broader CX strategy in view.

 - Hands-on experience taking AI-enabled features into production and owning their quality after launch, including accuracy, resolution rates, and knowing when a human should take over.

 - Direct Customer Experience or Revenue Operations experience

 - Building customer health or churn-prediction models, or working with product usage and behavioural data

 - Automated QA or knowledge-management platforms

 - Payments, spend-management or financial-data experience

 - SQL or data-querying skills

 - Managing global or multi-market customer platforms




WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

 - You believe technology should improve outcomes rather than just automate processes.

 - You want to be a trusted technical partner to CX leadership, Product and Engineering, helping build a connected, AI-enabled CX operating model.

 - Grow your skills as a trusted technical partner to CX leadership, Product and Engineering, helping build a connected, AI-enabled CX operating model and establishing the future-state CX technology architecture for Pleo’s next stage of growth.




THE LOCATION


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.




SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

 - Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

 - Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

 - Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

 - 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

 - For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

 - We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

 - Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

 1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

 2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minutes chat with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and role 

 3. Pleo Challenge and Panel Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 mins team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

 4. Final Interview: A final interview with a Senior Leader

ABOUT THE ROLE

This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in. 

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.




WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance.  - Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. You make that real, not aspirational.

 - Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity. 

 - Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.

 - Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.

 - Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.

 - Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.

 - Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.

 - Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.

 - Deep BigQuery and SQL expertise, including performance, cost considerations, and the architectural challenges of complex analytical domains.

 - Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.

 - AI-native development practice in a data engineering context. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a genuine part of how you work, and you can be specific about where they add real value and where they introduce risk in a governed analytics codebase.

 - A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority. 

 - Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime. 

 - Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.




WHY THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR YOU



This role is a good fit if:

 - You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.

 - You genuinely enjoy growing a community of practice through influence rather than authority and you take pride in seeing colleagues adopt and grow standards.

 - You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

This role is not a good fit if

 - You want to own a domain. The Intelligence teams have strong AEs doing that. This role is for someone who wants to own the standards they build to.

 - You advise others to use AI coding tools but don't use them yourself. AI-native development is part of the mandate, not a differentiating nice-to-have.

 - You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

By the end of your first six months, you'll have:

 - Contributed to the semantic layer tooling decision and begun onboarding the Analytics Engineers who'll build to it by writing documentation, running live sessions, reviewing PRs etc.

 - Established a visible presence in the AE community of practice and become someone whose feedback in code reviews and whose opinions on architecture are listened to because they've been demonstrated, not just stated.

 2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.

 3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.

 4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.

 - Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

rawCandidates.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Online Payments
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.



Your impact

As our Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll be leading go-to-market for Mollie's online payments product space. This is our core product offering and includes cards, Klarna, pay by bank and other products. You'll translate product capabilities and roadmap into positioning and coordinated marketing activity, connecting product strategy with execution across marketing, sales, and customer success.

A key and evolving focus of this role is Agentic Commerce, an emerging area involving AI facilitated shopping that requires deep technical knowledge and strategic partnerships with entities like Visa and Mastercard. You'll play a central role in building thought leadership and developing tools such as Generative Engine Optimization to support merchants navigating this space.

This role is particularly exciting because it ensures Mollie's core products are successfully brought to market and aligned with what customers actually need. By turning customer insight into strategic marketing initiatives, you'll directly support Mollie's commercial success.



What you'll ship

 - Go to market plans built with product teams, covering technical product understanding, value and benefits, positioning, value propositions, USPs, ICPs, use cases, and messaging

 - Coordinated launch activity across channel teams, bringing GTM plans to life in the market

 - A launch framework covering foundations, pre-launch, launch, early momentum, proof points, and ramp-up

 - Briefs, asset lists, and competitor research that support each launch

 - Project timelines kept current as product readiness or market events shift

 - Coordinated alignment between product and go-to-market teams when roadmap dependencies or external industry timing affect launch dates



What you'll bring

 - 5+ years of marketing experience, at least 3 of those in product marketing

 - End-to-end go-to-market planning experience, including ICP definition, positioning, and launch timelines

 - Experience in the online payments space or related areas, such as working with partners like Shopify. Prior fintech or payments exposure helps you ramp up quickly, but a strong technical product background from another vertical can also work

 - Strong messaging and positioning skills, with the ability to craft compelling value propositions and clear differentiation

 - Technical fluency, able to translate product specs, roadmaps, and integrations into GTM-ready language, with comfort using data platforms such as Looker, HubSpot, or other BI tools

 - Experience researching competitors and industry trends, running customer interviews or surveys, and using analytics tools to measure performance and shape strategy

 - Proven cross-functional project management

 - Strong presentation skills for internal decks and training



Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie https://jobs.mollie.com/ is really like.



AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings https://jobs.mollie.com/ai-manifesto that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
