rawCandidates.title: Senior Engineering Team Lead
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. 

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Team Lead to take ownership of our Reporting platform and lead the team responsible for its evolution. This is a player-coach role for a staff-level data engineer who combines deep technical expertise with strong engineering leadership and people management skills.

You will help design, deploy, and evolve the data infrastructure that powers Adikteev’s reporting and analytics systems. You will be both the technical architect of the platform and the manager of the team that enables reliable, scalable, and high-value reporting for our internal and external users.

As the team lead, you won't just "execute" tasks. You will shape our technical DNA and support the growth of the team.

Engineering:

  • Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Reporting platform and data infrastructure.

  • Architect, scale, and maintain our data infrastructure, ensuring it meets the rigorous demands of reporting, analytics, and business intelligence workflows.

  • Make sure data is always available and reliable: oversee processing, storage, aggregation, transformation, and API development.

  • Streamline our data processes by integrating efficient testing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and error recovery.

  • Design and implement robust data models and transformation pipelines that make reporting data easy to discover, understand, and use.

  • Build and optimize highly scalable pipelines using Apache Airflow and Apache Spark, focusing on high reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Establish best practices for data quality, CI/CD for data, observability, technical documentation, and operational excellence.

  • Contribute to innovation efforts by exploring promising ideas from recent academic and industry work and turning them into production-grade solutions.

  • Leverage AI coding tools such as Copilot and Claude to accelerate development cycles and stay at the forefront of engineering productivity.

  • Remain hands-on where it creates the most leverage, contributing to system design, code reviews, critical implementation work, and incident resolution.

Management:

  • Lead, support, and develop the Reporting engineering team, creating the conditions for engineers to do their best work.

  • Set clear objectives, priorities, and expectations for the team, aligned with company and product goals.

  • Manage the team’s roadmap and delivery, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt, and long-term investments.

  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and career development support to team members.

  • Mentor Data and Backend Engineers and help them grow their technical scope, ownership, and leadership skills.

  • Participate in recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, and team planning.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high engineering standards.

  • Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and technical risks before they impact the business, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

You might be a great fit for our Reporting team if you have experience in several of the following areas:

  • Experience: Proven track record as a Staff Data Engineer, Lead Data Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, or Engineering Manager with a strong data engineering background. You have worked on production systems where latency, throughput, availability, reliability, and infrastructure cost matter.

  • Data Volume: Experience working with very large-scale data systems. At Adikteev, our platforms process more than 5 billion events per day and reach over 5 million QPS on some services. You are comfortable designing systems that can handle high data volumes, demanding throughput, and strict reliability requirements.

  • Technical Stack: Hands-on expertise with Apache Spark, including tuning and scaling, as well as Apache Airflow and complex DAG orchestration. Kafka streaming, Kubernetes, and AWS are a plus.

  • Coding Skills: You are an "AI-native" developer who embraces AI tools to write better and faster code. Hands-on experience with Scala. Python and Java are a plus.

  • Data Modeling: Strong experience designing data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Experience with dimensional modeling, data warehouses, or data lakes is a plus.

  • Data Transformation: Solid understanding of how to transform raw data into accurate, consistent, and easy-to-use reporting datasets. Experience building or maintaining reporting or analytics platforms is a strong plus.

  • Engineering Leadership: Experience defining technical direction, setting engineering standards, driving execution across teams, and making architectural decisions at staff level.

  • People Management: Experience managing, mentoring, and developing engineers, providing regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a high-performing team.

  • Communication: Fluent in English and able to articulate complex architectural choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are comfortable creating alignment across teams and communicating clearly at every level.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive Salary between 100,000 and 120,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off);

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years;

  • Profit-sharing scheme

  • Healthcare plan with excellent coverage;

  • Lunch Vouchers;

  • Mental Health support;

  • Flexible remote working policy;

  • Regular team-life event / activity;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR call with Maxime, Team Lead - Talent Acquisition,

  • Technical interview with Youcef, Senior Engineering Team Lead, & Adrian, Senior Data Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Aldenis, VP Engineering, 

  • A final interview with Cédric, Chief Technology Officer and Loïc, Chief Product Officer. 

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

we're hiring our first PM at Claap. You'll own the core product across three big topics in-app agentic experience, off-app agentic experience and enterprise readiness working directly with Robin, our co-founder and CEO.

About Claap

Claap is the AI-native Revenue Intelligence platform for sales and revenue teams.

What makes us different: we were the first platform in our category designed from day one to be used by both humans AND AI agents. We were also the first in our category to release an MCP, back in May 2025, over 18 months ago. Every customer conversation we capture is structured for two consumers: the rep who needs to act on it, and the agents (yours, ours, third-party) that need to feed on it to do their work.

This matters because the biggest shift we see across our customer base, from Series B startups to enterprise customers like Infopro Digital, Didomi, Dash0, and Pelico, is the move toward collaboration between humans, agents, and software. Our customers' executives are under real pressure to deploy AI across sales, business development, and customer-facing functions. Claap is often the conversation-data backbone that makes those agentic workflows possible.

Claap is now part of lempire (lemlist), giving us the ambition to build the agentic revenue platform (from prospection to closing) of the next decade.

We're a small team. Every hire matters and we are looking for our 1st PM.

As the first Product Manager at Claap, your mission is to drive the product's future developments and roadmap, working hand in hand with Robin, our co-founder and CEO, who has led product since day one.

You will work with Robin on three big topics:

- In-app agentic experience: In the past few months, we have extended our context infra. We now need to put this context at work to truly move the needle for our sales clients and help them close faster. Think next best action for the sales rep (prep meeting, build decks, contact people, follow ups & co), assisted pipeline reviews & forecasts or sales coaching.

- Off-app agentic experience: Claap is becoming headless, consumed more and more through MCP. We now need to level up our MCP integrations to make Claap fully sticky and efficient through MCP usage in 3rd party agents. Think MCP tools, plugins, embed skills or Claude artifact app.

- Enterprise readiness: our customers are moving upmarket, and enterprise accounts need governance, admin settings, permissions and configuration capabilities to roll Claap out at scale. Think SSO/SCIM, roles and permissions, data retention policies, and admin analytics.

The lemlist integration and our end-to-end sales agent roadmap will stay with Robin, which leaves you real ownership on the core Claap product (ie closing).

Your role is to understand the market and customer needs (especially in this AI era), identify the best possible product evolutions, prioritize them, work hand-in-hand with developers and designers to build an amazing product experience, and have a strong focus on go-to-market with Sales and Marketing to make sure the impact is reached.

Your scope can change over time; we are a truly agile company: we iterate a lot, even on how we organize and work together.

The PM at Claap wears different hats

- A detective/explorer hat to find unusual insights & opportunities, read between the lines of what sales teams really need, and be visionary when needed

- A chess player hat to think strategically, create good decision constraints, double down on the right things, and always have a coup d'avance

- An investor hat to make the right bets at the right time with the right amount of resources, because you sometimes need to play fast and risky, and sometimes need to play safe

Context

  • Satisfaction: set up and follow NPS campaigns.

  • Adoption: run campaigns to increase usage of Parallel across our customers.

  • Product feedback: share what you see in the field and work with Product on levers to increase usage.

  • Management: manage two experienced people, set the framework and priorities, help them grow and structure the team as the number of accounts increases.

Who you are

  • You have 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, with your own B2B customer portfolio.

  • You have already managed people, even an intern, and you have the credibility to lead two experienced people.

  • You have already set up NPS campaigns and done account monitoring: you know which indicators you track and how you detect an account in trouble.

  • You make decisions on your own on an account and raise the alarm when a metric drops.

  • You want to keep working directly on accounts on top of managing: this is not a pure management role.

  • A plus: experience with key account portfolios.

Our values

  • Play to Win: we're not here to just take part, deliver something "good enough" or simply enjoy the startup ride. We want to win. That means caring about results, moving fast and bringing the right intensity when it matters.

We don't want a company built on approvals, control and micromanagement. But trust comes with accountability: the more freedom you have, the higher the bar.

We want Parallel to remain a place where people enjoy spending time together, laughing, celebrating and giving energy to others. High standards and a good atmosphere aren't opposites: we want both.

Hiring process

  1. Call with the Hiring Team (30 min)

  2. Call with Clémentine, Head of Ops and your future manager (30 min)

  3. An afternoon at our office to present your case and meet the founders (2 hours)

  4. Reference check

Why join us?

  • A role to build: you lay the foundations of customer success at Parallel (metrics, campaigns, team organisation).

  • A key role: customer success weighs heavily on Parallel's reputation, and you are the right hand of the Head of Ops on this topic.

  • Real traction: seed and Series A ($20M with Index Ventures) closed in less than a year, more than 800 clients and a team of over 30 people.

  • Strong investors and founders: Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI; founders who come from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo.

  • A complete package: competitive salary and BSPCE, Alan health insurance, Swile meal vouchers, Apple equipment, 50% of public transport covered.

  • The team: a team event every month and two offsites a year.

  • Our office: Paris 2nd arrondissement.

  • Flexibility: on average one remote day per week and one remote week per year.

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.
If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE ROLE

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation.
Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection
  • Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes
  • Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes
  • Assurer le sourcing matière
  • Établir les fiches de lancement et suivre les corrections de prototypes
  • Réaliser les dessins techniques
  • Participer aux essayages
  • Accompagner les pièces jusqu'à la normalisation, en lien avec les usines
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL

Vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'environ 2 ans en tant que designer junior, idéalement sur le jersey et/ou le flou.

Vous avez également :

  • Une sensibilité forte pour le bien aller du vêtement, avec un attrait pour le flou et le travail en 3D
  • La maîtrise de la suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et une aisance en dessin technique
  • Un esprit autonome, débrouillard et force de proposition
  • La capacité à prendre rapidement des automatismes et à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle
  • L'envie d'évoluer au sein d'un studio créatif exigeant
 
 
Le poste est basé à Paris dans le 8ème arrondissement

You’ll own revenue growth within the customer, understand their operations, build relationships across their organisation, and turn successful deployments into agreements to expand. You’ll have the autonomy and responsibility to make it happen.

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup and take real ownership from the start

  • Commercially minded, analytical and motivated by measurable results

What you bring

  • A STEM degree and the curiosity to understand our technology and its practical applications

  • The ability to align stakeholders across operations, technical teams, procurement and senior management

  • An ambitious team building a product with huge potential

  • The opportunity to apply your analytical and commercial skills to real robotics deployments at scale

  • Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear

Flink Robotics is a fast-paced startup backed by world-class VCs, originating from the Computational Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to autonomy. Our systems are designed to revolutionize material handling - from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.

We’re looking for a Lead Deployment Engineer who will take charge of scaling our deployment activities across Europe. This is a role for someone who thrives both hands-on in the field and in leading and coordinating multiple deployments as we roll out robots at customer sites. You’ll shape how our robots are brought into production environments, ensuring smooth installations, happy customers, and continuous improvements that set new standards in logistics automation.

Who you are

  • Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early growth phase and own the deployment function end-to-end.

  • Experienced in logistics automation, with a proven track record of rolling out complex robotic or automation systems in production environments.

  • A leader who balances hands-on problem-solving with the ability to coordinate and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Clear communicator, fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • Excited about frequent travel to customer sites across Europe (up to 50%).

  • Skilled at building trust with customers and collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience in designing, testing, deploying and commissioning automation, robotics, or other machinery in industrial settings.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering, mechatronics, sensors, networking, and control systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to organize, manage, and prioritize multiple deployment projects in parallel.

  • Proven leadership experience: mentoring and building field/deployment teams.

  • Strong diagnostic skills for both hardware and software issues, and confidence in high-pressure environments.

  • Familiarity with Linux and modern deployment practices is a plus.

  • Driver’s license and proficiency in German or other European languages are advantages.

What you’ll do

  • Lead deployments: Plan, organize, and oversee robot installations across Europe, ensuring smooth execution and customer satisfaction.

  • Build and scale the team: Recruit, train, and mentor deployment engineers as we expand across markets.

  • Customer interface: Act as the technical lead in the field, ensuring a smooth handover and training for customer operators.

  • Feedback loop: Collect insights from deployments and feed them back into product and engineering to drive reliability and new features.

  • Drive standards: Develop and refine processes, documentation, and playbooks to enable repeatable, reliable deployments.

Why join

  • A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential.

  • Work at the cutting edge of robotics, where real-world impact meets world-class research.

  • Take a central role in scaling a function critical to Flink’s growth.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear.

  • Work in a central office in Zurich and across Europe with our partners.

Apply now if you’re ready to push the boundaries of robot automation!

sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

rawCandidates.title: Product Frontend Engineer
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

About the Role

Every month, hundreds of potential customers show interest in Trengo. They start a free trial, request a demo, or leave their contact details. But not everyone gets the personal follow-up they need to take the next step.

That's where you come in.

As our Marketing Development Representative (MDR), you'll be the first personal point of contact for potential customers, helping them find the right way to get started with Trengo.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

This is a hands-on junior role where you'll get to learn how a fast-moving AI SaaS company turns marketing efforts into revenue, with plenty of room to experiment, develop your skills, and make a measurable impact.

It's an 8-month contract with the possibility of extension.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

  • Be the first personal point of contact for new inbound leads, reaching out through calls and personalised emails, ideally within the same working day.

  • Follow up with qualified free-trial sign-ups, demo requests and prospects who have expressed interest but haven't booked a meeting.

  • Re-engage prospects whose meetings weren't booked, were cancelled or resulted in a no-show, and help them take the next step.

  • Connect qualified prospects with the right Account Executive, making sure they have the context needed for a productive conversation.

Help prospects become self-serve customers

  • Reach out to prospects who might not be the right fit for a sales conversation but could still benefit from Trengo.

  • Understand what they're looking for, answer initial questions and guide them towards the right self-serve plan.

  • Follow up with free-trial users to help them get started and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Improve how we engage with leads

  • Experiment with different outreach messages, sequences and follow-up approaches to understand what converts best.

  • Share insights with Marketing and Sales about common objections, lead quality and what prospects are looking for.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate and up to date by logging interactions, tracking outcomes and maintaining clean lead data.

How we'll measure success

You'll have a direct impact on our growth, with clear results you can track:

  • Speed of follow-up: Making sure inbound prospects receive timely, personal attention.

  • Meetings generated: Booking qualified meetings that turn into conversations with our Account Executives.

  • Self-serve conversions: Helping prospects progress from initial interest to becoming paying customers.

  • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

The tools you'll work with

You'll get hands-on experience with our commercial and AI toolkit:

  • HubSpot: CRM, lead management, outreach sequences and calling.

  • RevenueHero: Lead routing and meeting booking.

  • Fathom: Call recordings, feedback and coaching.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • AI tools: Researching prospects, personalising outreach and experimenting with smarter ways of working.

What you’ll bring

  • 1-2 years of experience, ideally through an internship or an early-career role in sales, marketing, customer success or a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Dutch is a big plus.

  • Confidence in communication: You're comfortable picking up the phone, writing personalised emails and starting conversations with people you haven't met.

  • A proactive mindset: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You spot opportunities and take initiative.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

You'll join our Growth Marketing team and work closely with Sales, sitting right at the intersection of marketing and sales. You'll turn the demand we generate into real business opportunities, whether that's booking a meeting with an Account Executive or helping someone become a paying customer through our self-serve journey.

About Trengo

What your role looks like:

Turn inbound interest into opportunities

How we'll measure success

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

rawCandidates.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Agent Builder
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
Auditors sign their name to every conclusion. An agent can do the heavy lifting, but only if the auditor can see how each conclusion was reached and trace it back to its source.

Agent Builder is where firms turn their own procedures into agents their whole team can run, in Alwin by DataSnipper, our agentic automation platform for audit and finance. Built well, an agent makes quality a property of the procedure, not of who happened to be staffed on the engagement.

You'll own Agent Builder and the agents firms build with it. Your users are the people at firms who build agents, and the methodology and quality teams who approve them for client work.

This is a technical PM role. You'll shape the harness each agent runs in: the context it sees, the tools it uses, and where a person reviews its work. You'll own the feedback loops that improve agents after release. You'll work as a peer to the Agent Builder engineering team, and with our Agent Runtime and Evals teams here in Amsterdam.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

The problems you'll own

  • A firm's procedure must become a harness an agent can follow, with the right context, tools and review points

  • Models are non-deterministic, but audit work must be defensible: traceable, attributed and reviewed

  • A firm will only rely on an agent it can test, approve and trace

  • Reviewer feedback must make agents better, with the firm's approval and without anything reaching another client

  • Methodology, models and standards all change. Agents in use must keep up without breaking work in progress

What you'll do

  • Own the Agent Builder strategy and roadmap, and make the trade-offs explicit

  • Design the harness with engineering: how context is assembled, how tools are defined and called, and where a person must review

  • Decide what builders control and what the platform sets, so agents can encode real methodology and stay consistent

  • Build the feedback loops: turn run traces and reviewer edits into eval cases, regression tests and changes the firm approves

  • Set the quality gates an agent must pass before release, and test every new model or methodology version before it reaches live work

  • Report agent quality with a stated method and sample

  • Prototype in code before you write specs. Then write short specs and decision memos that engineers can build from

  • Spend time with the firms that build and approve agents, and turn what our forward-deployed teams learn into product, not one-off fixes

What you bring

  • A technical background: software, ML or infrastructure engineering, or several years as a technical PM on developer or AI platforms

  • Hands-on experience shipping agent systems in production: context and retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, retries and fallbacks

  • Eval practice: building datasets, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, offline and online evaluation, and regression testing across model versions

  • Observability for LLM systems: traces, cost and latency, and classifying failures so you fix causes, not symptoms

  • System design skills: schemas, versioning, permissions, event logs and APIs. You can read a design doc and challenge it

  • PM experience on a product that other people build on

  • Prototyping in code with AI tools as part of your normal work

  • Clear, short writing

What sets you apart

  • Audit or accounting knowledge, from practice or from building products for auditors, finance teams or other experts in regulated fields

  • Document AI: extraction, OCR, grounding and citation

  • You've built an agent harness or framework, eval tooling, or LLM observability

  • You've built review workflows or feedback pipelines that turn user corrections into eval or training data

  • Experience with low-code tools, workflow designers, rule engines or DSLs

  • Design-partner programmes with large enterprise customers

What We Offer

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

 

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

rawCandidates.title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market.

You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners.

Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website.

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Where the website stands today

Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com. Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration.

In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of.

Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started.

AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up.

Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site.

The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked.

What you'll be doing

Run the experimentation program

  • Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout.

  • Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test.

  • Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test.

  • Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session.

Improve conversion where buyers decide

  • Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages.

  • Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it.

  • Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market.

Personalize the site

  • Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage.

  • Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what.

  • Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site.

Build AI into the web program

  • Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor.

  • Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month.

  • Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results.

  • Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions.

Manage web projects

  • Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer.

  • Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits.

  • Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result.

Keep the site findable and measurable

  • Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access.

  • Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way.

  • Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Build the weekly web performance view the team works from.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost.

  • Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot.

  • Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships.

  • Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes.

  • AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first.

  • Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist):

Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself.

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference.

This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations.

What you'll do

  • Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signals yourself, with our Data team reviewing your work.

  • Build automated plays across email and in-app messaging in tools like HubSpot and Chameleon, starting with new customers who haven’t adopted the product yet. You also automate the processes around your plays yourself, including AI steps. Every play defines when a customer goes to a pooled CSM, for example when there’s a cancellation signal or no response to the automated steps.

  • Every play runs against a control group. Ship a small version first, measure whether the effect is real or noise, improve what works and stop what doesn’t.

  • Write and maintain the customer communication for your plays across email, in-app and agent instructions, in language that fits our brand.

  • Shape agent specs and prompts that AI engineering builds from: tasks, rules, examples and when to hand over to a person. Define test cases and quality criteria, and check the agent’s work every week the way you would a team member’s.

  • Work with the onboarding squad, Content & Community, Product Marketing and RevOps so plays fit their designs and don’t clash with launches or product tours, and help decide which CS tools we build on.

Your first year

  • First 3 months: you find the first signals and set baselines together with our Data team.

  • After 4 months: your first plays for new customers are live, each running against a control group.

  • By the end of your first year: around 8 plays are live, at least 5 of them with a proven effect, and you’ve run a first pilot with an AI agent.

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years driving scaled adoption or retention for a large customer base, for example in scaled or digital Customer Success, CS or Revenue Operations, lifecycle or CRM marketing, or growth, at a SaaS or subscription business.

  • Proven experience turning product usage data into health scores, signals or lifecycle triggers.

  • A track record of one-to-many programs with results you can show in numbers, including how you knew the change came from the program and not something else.

  • No need to wait for an admin: you build workflows and sequences yourself in tools like HubSpot, or Chameleon.

  • Solid SQL skills: you write and read it independently.

Nice to haves

  • You’ve built a CS program or function from scratch (0 to 1), not only taken one over.

  • Hands-on work with agent specs or AI-supported workflows in a CS or support setting, and using AI daily for writing, analysis and testing while knowing its limits: wrong answers, privacy, and when a person has to step in.

  • A background in the live event, AV or equipment rental industry.

  • Experience in Git and pull requests

What you’ll get

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

rawCandidates.descriptionText:
BlockTech is hiring a Software Engineer to join its Mid-Office team in Amsterdam.

Positions, PnL, and hedging all run through Mid-Office. When a number our traders or risk team rely on is wrong, this is where it gets found and fixed.

In this role, you'll build and run that platform, and you'll be the one who follows a wrong number until you know why.

About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

The Mid-Office team owns the systems that keep positions, PnL, and hedging correct across every venue we trade. We work in Python, with Grafana and PostgreSQL alongside.

What will you do?

You will build and own the systems that keep our books and data accurate, including the quantitative work behind them. You'll be responsible for spotting discrepancies, investigating unexpected numbers, and tracing issues to their root cause.

You will:

  • Own the books. Maintain and evolve our position, trade, and PnL systems so they stay accurate across every venue.

  • Do the quant work. Build and refine our hedging, Greeks, margin models, and early exercise premium calculations.

  • Surface the risk. Build the risk views and calculations that show traders and the risk team what exposure we're carrying.

  • Support the desk. Work side by side with traders and researchers, and make sure the data they rely on is correct and available.

  • Deliver reporting. Provide the data internal stakeholders and regulators need: PnL breakdowns, trade surveillance, treasury accounting, and compliance.

  • Own it in production. Spot discrepancies in live data, trace the root cause, and maintain what you ship.

What we're looking for

You'll need:

  • You'll need to be an engineer at heart, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine passion for building and improving systems.

  • A relevant educational background, ideally in a quantitative field such as mathematics, econometrics, or computer science.

  • Professional experience with Python, Grafana, and PostgreSQL.

  • Strong debugging skills. You can trace problems to their source, even in unfamiliar systems.

  • A critical mind that follows problems through to completion, high ownership, and clear communication in English.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in finance, ideally trading, on the systems behind positions, PnL, risk, and hedging.

Pay, location, and relocation

  • Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a performance bonus based on individual and company results.

  • Trading fund: outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office

  • Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

  • Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% tax ruling.

What else is in it for you

  • Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

  • An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

  • Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

  • Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

You'll be challenged and stretched in this role, with plenty of room to grow within and beyond your main responsibilities. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Ready to own the numbers the desk trades on?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.

rawCandidates.title: Senior Process Integration Engineer
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Senior Process Integration Engineer, you will play a key role in translating new technologies and products from development into robust, scalable, and manufacturable processes. You will work closely with Engineering, R&D, Product, Operations, and Quality teams to develop, integrate, optimise, and release processes and products into manufacturing.

Your work will be essential in ensuring that new products and technologies can be reliably manufactured with the required performance, quality, and yield.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the integration and transfer of new products, processes and technologies from R&D into manufacturing.

  • Define and develop manufacturing process flows, process specifications and control strategies for new product introductions.

  • Work closely with R&D and cross-functional teams to ensure new products are designed and released with manufacturability, quality and scalability in mind.

  • Plan and execute process integration activities, including process development, qualification, validation, and release.

  • Identify, investigate and resolve process integration issues, yield losses, and technical anomalies.

  • Drive continuous process and yield improvements using structured problem-solving and data-driven approaches.

  • Support the transition and scaling of manufacturing capabilities, including the implementation of new equipment, automation, and MES systems.

  • Develop and maintain key process and quality documentation, including Process FMEAs, Control Plans, process specifications, work instructions and change control documentation.

  • Participate in and support technical review and decision-making processes, including Change Control Boards (CCB) and Material Review Boards (MRB).

  • Work with Operations and Manufacturing teams to establish stable, repeatable, and scalable manufacturing processes.

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers as the Process Integration team grows.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of experience in Process Integration, Process Engineering, NPI, Yield Engineering, or a related engineering role.

  • A Master's or PhD degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

  • Experience working in a semiconductor startup, microfabrication foundry, advanced manufacturing or other high-tech hardware environment.

  • Strong understanding of process development, process integration, qualification, and manufacturing transfer.

  • Experience with structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, SPC, DOE or similar tools.

  • Experience in analysing process and manufacturing data to identify root causes and improve process performance and yield.

  • Familiarity with quality and manufacturing systems, including Control Plans, non-conformance management, change control and corrective/preventive actions.

  • Experience working in cross-functional environments involving R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality.

  • Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

  • Experience with semiconductor fabrication of superconducting devices or quantum technologies would be a nice to have.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

rawCandidates.title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
rawCandidates.descriptionText:
AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken.

Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

  • Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

  • Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

  • Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

  • Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

  • Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

  • Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.


We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

  • De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

  • Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen.

  • Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen.

  • Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

  • Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript.

  • Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies.

  • Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening.

Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken.

Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren.

We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen.

We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag. Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Internet-, telefonie- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • €750 per jaar voor boeken, workshops, seminars of andere dingen die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Een aanvullend studiebudget van €2.500 per jaar.

  • Een vast aantal studie-uren per jaar, zodat je ook daadwerkelijk tijd kunt besteden aan je ontwikkeling.

  • €550 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek.

  • Onze participatieregeling Good Shares, waarmee je mede-eigenaar kunt worden van de organisatie.

  • Een pensioenbijdrage van 5,3%, volledig door ons betaald.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en een NS-Business Card. Ons kantoor zit pal naast station Almere Centraal.

  • En verschillende extra's, zoals stoelmassages, vers bereide (warme) lunches op kantoor en korting op je sportabonnement.

Enthousiast?

Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van mogelijkheden, het bouwen van slimme oplossingen en het helpen van anderen om technologie écht te benutten?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. Dat mag vanuit je werkervaring zijn, maar ook vanuit eigen projecten of andere initiatieven.

Bij ons is iedereen welkom om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, identiteit of persoonlijke omstandigheden.

Heb je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure bepaalde ondersteuning of aanpassingen nodig? Laat het ons gerust weten, dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden.

Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas

ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector.

ONE-Dyas onderzoekt tevens actief mogelijkheden op het gebied van koolstofafvang en -opslag, en groene waterstof als toekomstige energieoplossingen.

ONE-Dyas, met het hoofdkantoor aan de Zuidas in Amsterdam en circa 150 medewerkers, kenmerkt zich door een sterke ondernemingscultuur, korte lijnen tussen alle disciplines en een hechte band met haar aandeelhouders, wat leidt tot een doelgerichte en effectieve werkomgeving. Mensen maken Matrix
